area_description: Wealth can provide people with financial security and broaden their opportunities to make long-term decisions and invest in their own future. At the same time, significant disparities in the distribution of wealth can lead to considerable differences in financial security and life chances. Examining wealth inequality complements the analysis of current income by addressing the question of how permanently available economic resources are distributed within society.
